items.title: 7.4 Rate law, rate constant aur reaction ka order (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4, printed page 154.

blocks.text: Kisi darja hararat par reaction ki rate ek ya zyada reactants aur products ki concentrations par munhasir ho sakti hai. Agle topics rate law aur rate constant, reaction ka order, order ki qismein, aur rate constant ki units ki tareef karte hain.

blocks.alt: Aam rate law rate = k [A]^x [B]^y wala banner. Baen: NO aur H2 reaction ki initial-rate table notes ke saath jo H2 mein pehla order aur NO mein doosra order parhte hain. Daen: hydrogen peroxide aur iodide ka data k ke hisab aur half-life formula ke saath. Neeche: orders 0 se 3 aur ek fractional order ke liye k ki units ki table, misalon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Rate law, reaction ka order aur rate constant ki units (Tables 7.2 aur 7.3 aur chhape hue units ke ishtiqaq ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Rate law ke exponents tajurbe se aate hain: [H2] dugna karne se rate dugni hoti hai (pehla order) jabke [NO] dugna karne se chaar guna (doosra order), to reaction kul teesre order ki hai. Napi hui initial rate ko concentrations se taqseem karne se k milta hai, peroxide-iodide reaction ke liye 1.75 x 10^-2 dm3 mol-1 s-1, jis mein [H+] ka koi asar nahi. k ki units k = (mol dm-3)^(1-n) s-1 se aati hain: zero order ke liye mol dm-3 s-1, pehle ke liye s-1, doosre ke liye dm3 mol-1 s-1 aur teesre ke liye dm6 mol-2 s-1.

blocks.prompt: Reaction ka order us ke balanced muadle se kyun nahi parha ja sakta?
blocks.explanation: Balanced muadla sirf kul stoichiometry, reactants aur products ke mole tanasub, deta hai. Rate mechanism par munhasir hai, khas kar is par ke sab se sust qadam mein kaun si species hissa leti hain, to rate law ke exponents tajurbe se dhoondne hote hain aur coefficients ke barabar ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi.

items: Rate law rate ko tajurbati exponents ke saath concentrations se jorta hai; k rate constant hai aur exponents ka majmooa order (tafseel 7.4.1 se 7.4.4 mein).
